description: 2020年高雄市健康便利站-橋頭區 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 高雄市政府衛生局. 醫事機構代碼、醫療院所名稱、電話、子宮頸抹片檢查(●：篩檢○：諮詢或轉介)、乳房攝影檢查(●：篩檢○：諮詢或轉介)、糞便潛血檢查(●：篩檢○：諮詢或轉介)、口腔黏膜檢查(●：篩檢○：諮詢或轉介)、地址. Coverage: 高雄市政府衛生局. The portal files it under the publisher 高雄市政府衛生局. Its tags are 就醫. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
